  • Liefermanagement: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung, wenn die Lkw mit frischen Waren ankommen, und sorgst dafür, dass alles passt! Und wenn etwas fehlt, organisierst du blitzschnell Nachlieferungen – du behältst immer den Überblick über die Logistik in deinem Standort.
  • Prozessmanagement: Du hältst den Betrieb am Laufen durch einen kontinuierlichen Fokus auf unsere betrieblichen Kennzahlen (KPIs) und garantierst, dass alles sicher und wie am Schnürchen läuft, ganz nach unserem Motto: “Safety First”.
  • Teamwork: Im engen Austausch mit dem Customer-Success Team, unserem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) und anderen Hubs machst du unsere Kunden glücklich.
  • Pünktliche Abfahrten: Dank dir sind unsere Fahrer immer pünktlich unterwegs zu unseren Kunden, damit wir unser versprochenes Zeitfenster einhalten können.
  • Bringe deine Ideen ein: Von der Koordination der Reparatur unserer Elektrofahrzeuge über die Gestaltung des Hub Layouts bis hin zur Rekrutierung unserer Runner - deine Ideen tragen dazu bei, dass wir gemeinsam weiter wachsen können und unsere Logistikprozesse auf ein neues Level bringen.

 

Das bringst du mit 

  • Ein Studium oder abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung in der Logistik, dem Einzelhandel oder in ähnlichen Bereichen. 
  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Führung von Teams - entweder im Beruf oder du hast bereits ein anderes Erfolgsteam gecoached.
  • Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
  • Du bist im Besitz eines gültigen Führerscheins der Klasse B.
  • Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten und ein selbstbewusstes Auftreten.
  • Du magst es, Entscheidungen auf Grundlage von Zahlen und Fakten zu treffen. 

 

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich. voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. In unseren Hubs steht dir jederzeit ein gut gefüllter Kühlschrank mit frischen Snacks, Getränken und Obst zur Verfügung – damit du bestens versorgt bist, wenn dich der Hunger packt.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Individuelle Mobilität: Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. Wir bieten ein subventioniertes Deutschlandticket und ein „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm an. 
  • Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.

Bereit für die Herausforderung? Dann bewirb dich, werde Teil des Picnic Teams und hilf uns dabei, zum besten Milchmann in Deutschland zu werden!

description:
About The Company

GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with a wide range of design options, automated offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company is able to create resilient timber housing quickly and cost-effectively. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, strengthen Europe’s innovation capacity, and play a substantial role in improving sustainability. The company delivers its multi-family houses as a complete and turnkey solution. The combination of technology, construction, robotics, and manufacturing expertise means buildings can be created in a fully digitalized end-to-end process. The building system is based on versatile wall and slab elements, making it easier to optimize land use, customize plans, and build fast with both off-site construction and on-site assembly. This system is complemented by the Building Operating System–developed in-house.

About the Role 

Join GROPYUS and lead the development of a world-class cost optimization function for our building systems. Working at the intersection of product development, engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and construction, you will drive cost competitiveness across the entire building lifecycle. 

As Head of Cost Optimization - Building Systems, you will define the strategy, methodologies, and governance for cost optimization across our product portfolio. You will establish a data-driven understanding of cost drivers, identify opportunities for value creation, and ensure that cost considerations are embedded into product and system decisions from concept through industrialized delivery. 

This is a strategic leadership role for someone who combines deep cost expertise with strong industrial, technical, and commercial thinking. You will build and lead the cost optimization capability, challenge assumptions, and help shape the future evolution of GROPYUS' building systems. 

Your area of responsibilities include:  

  • Define and lead the Building Systems Cost Optimization strategy, ensuring cost competitiveness, scalability, and value creation across the product portfolio 
  • Co-develop design-to-cost, should-costing, value engineering, and target-costing methodologies across product development, manufacturing, procurement, and construction functions 
  • Drive systematic identification and prioritization of cost optimization opportunities for building systems, components, materials, and interfaces 
  • Build transparent cost models and feedback loops, ensuring continuous learning from estimated versus actual cost performance 
  • Lead and develop the Cost Optimization team, creating clear standards, processes, and capabilities to support business growth 
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Construction, and R&D leaders to embed cost awareness into strategic and operational decision-making 

 

About You 

Must-Have Skills 

  • Extensive experience in cost engineering, product costing, value engineering, cost optimization, or commercial leadership, ideally within the broader construction industry sector 
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional cost reduction initiatives and delivering measurable business impact 
  • Strong understanding of complex product and system cost structures, including materials, manufacturing, supply chains, and installation costs 
  • Demonstrated leadership experience building teams, influencing senior stakeholders, and driving organizational change 
  • Strong data-driven mindset with a solid understanding of digital tools, analytics, and performance measurement frameworks 
  • Usual business travel between our sites expected 
  • Fluent English language skills 

 

Nice-to-Have Skills 

  • Experience with industrialized construction, modular building systems, prefabrication, or high-volume manufacturing environments 
  • Familiarity with timber construction, building systems (MEP, façade, structural systems), German-speaking construction markets, and digital costing tools 
  • Lean Six Sigma certification and/or demonstrated experience applying continuous improvement methodologies in complex operational environments 
  • Fluent German language skills  

 

What we offer 

  • An unlimited contract with 30 vacation days. 
  • Flexible work: We value regular in‑person collaboration in the office, while also offering working from home and the opportunity to work up to 40 days a year from abroad.
  • Attractive perks and benefits: We offer a company pension scheme, language courses (English/German), and employee discounts with selected sustainable brands. Furthermore, our external partners in mental health support you in strengthening your mental health through anonymous private/group sessions.  
  • Virtual Shares Program: Participate in the success of GROPYUS through our Virtual Share Program. 
  • Ownership: You can truly make your mark with your work and contributions – on  all our organizational levels. Find your solutions, drive and test them. 
  • The chance to be part of something big: Our mission is to rethink an entire industry. Join us in reinventing construction and fostering sustainable, affordable living.  
  • A diverse and enriching work environment: Become a valued member of a wonderfully diverse team of individuals from over 50 countries. At GROPYUS we value inclusion above all, ensuring that everyone feels they belong – no matter their background. In this way, our differences become strengths that help us grow as a team.  

Join us on our mission to design buildings as continuously evolving products to create the most exciting and affordable experience for all. We build for people and conserve the resources of our planet.

We can't wait to get to know you.

description: SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed. The Role As a Junior Computational Geometry Engineer, you work on the geometry core of our Manufacturing Intelligence stack: the engine that takes an arbitrary customer CAD model, reasons about how to build it, and then proves that we built it right. You start on well-scoped parts of that engine, next to the engineers who built it, and grow into owning them. Your code runs in the factory. What We're Looking For Foundations. Degree in computer science, mathematics, mechanical engineering or a related field, with real depth in geometry, linear algebra and numerics. Internships, thesis work or serious side projects count. We do not expect years of production experience. B-rep Basics. You are comfortable with topology, NURBS, meshes and point clouds. You may never have shipped a robust boolean, and you still understand why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations, and you want to learn how the field handles it. Kernel Exposure. You have worked with a geometry kernel and mesh libraries in at least one project: OpenCASCADE, CGAL, libigl, Open3D, PCL, Parasolid or comparable. Technical Ability. Solid modern C++ (17+) plus Python for tooling and rapid iteration. Rust is welcome. You write code others can read, test and maintain. Manufacturing Curiosity. You want to understand what happens once geometry meets a spindle, a nozzle or a fixture. CNC, additive or metrology exposure is a bonus, never a requirement. First Principles Thinker. You reason by physics and mathematics, not analogy. When an algorithm fails on a real part, you dig until you know whether the bug sits in the code, the model or the assumption. Learning Speed. You take direct feedback, apply it immediately, and close your own knowledge gaps without waiting to be taught. Industrial Grit. You want to stand next to the machine in Germany and watch your output run. The feedback loop between your code and cutting metal is the point. On-site. Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland. What we're not looking for Researchers who want to publish and hand off. You ship. CAD users. This is a role for people who build the tools, not drive them. Engineers who need a clean spec. The problem is defined by the part, the machine, and the customer - you'll help define it. People who treat “it works on the test model” as done. Real customer CAD is broken, degenerate, and adversarial. That is the job. Engineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities. What we offer Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the West. Your work directly enables production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space. Total Ownership: High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions - and have the authority to execute. The Environment: Access to a 8,000 m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial 3D printers. Your algorithms run on real hardware from day one. The Team: "Special Forces" model. Everyone senior, everyone ships. No politics, no bureaucracy. Direct feedback, high standards. Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity. Location: Zurich HQ, with occasional time at Factory ONE in Munich. Apply Resume: Focus on the geometry work you have actually done. Thesis, internships, projects, coursework. GitHub/Portfolio: Show us the hardest problem you have solved. Code, a write-up, or a part that came off a machine because of you. Coverletter: Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first? As a principal engineer working across the entire frontend stack, from design-system primitives to product-level architecture, you will shape how developers build with Algolia and how customers experience our products.

In the Frontend Experiences team, we're on a mission to make it effortless for developers to build great search and discovery experiences on the front end, with libraries, components and tooling that are fast, accessible, and a pleasure to use. Our work reaches customers and their end users directly, on the web and on mobile, so the quality bar is high and the feedback loop is short.


Right now, that includes a cross-team, multi-quarter effort to evolve the Algolia Dashboard from a collection of product surfaces into one coherent environment: a new navigation and information architecture, a shared component foundation, and an interaction model that supports traditional configuration, conversational assistance and agentic workflows side by side.


The team is looking for an experienced individual who is well versed in defining, building and operating scalable architectures, with proven strengths in cross-team collaboration, taking solutions all the way through delivery to adoption by other engineering teams and by customers. You will play a pivotal role in architecting and implementing systems that play a central role across all of Algolia's front-end products, including libraries that run in production on thousands of customer sites. You will also play a role in training/mentoring and leading team members.

  • Defining the multi-year technical vision for Algolia's front-end platform, and turning it into roadmaps and projects that several teams can execute;
  • Playing an active role in the evolution of the Algolia Dashboard: shaping the experience architecture, the component strategy and the technical foundations for conversational and agentic UX, and partnering with engineering, product and design leadership to sequence delivery;
  • Driving convergence on a shared component library, reducing duplicated components and inconsistent patterns across product surfaces;
  • Designing and delivering solutions that will scale with significant volumes, be highly available, performant and resilient, including on pages and apps we do not control;
  • Owning solutions, taking them all the way through delivery to adoption by engineering teams and customers;
  • Shaping API design, versioning and backward-compatibility strategy for public libraries used by a large developer community;
  • Embodying technical expertise, that the team can refer to for advice or validation of a solution;
  • Setting engineering standards and best practices to be followed by engineers

  • Deep frontend expertise (TypeScript, modern web platform, React and other major frameworks, accessibility, bundle size and runtime performance)

  • Preference for candidates with experience at our current stage and beyond (over 10,000 customers, $50-200M ARR range, high growth, lots of change and building internal infrastructure).

description:
Contexte :

Offre de stage de recherche de master d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, débutant en hiver 2026-2027. Ce document liste les possibles directions pour le stage, qui seront ajustées au fil du stage. Le stage aura lieu au sein du centre de recherche d’Artefact à Paris.

L’objectif est d'étudier les réseaux de neurones dans un cadre où l’on souhaite garantir l'indépendance des prédictions vis-à-vis d'une variable sensible continue (telle que l'âge, le revenu, la couleur de peau, etc.).

Présentation d’Artefact :

Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en transformation data, dont la mission est de transformer la donnée  en délivrant des résultats tangibles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur des entreprises. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 employés allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit  de l’innovation business des entreprises. Nos technologies de pointe en Intelligence Artificielle, nos méthodes agiles garantissent le succès des projets IA de nos clients, de la conception au déploiement, jusqu’à la formation et l’accompagnement au changement.

Sujet :

Les réseaux de neurones sont aujourd'hui au cœur de nombreuses applications industrielles. Leur capacité à extraire des représentations riches à partir des données en fait des outils de choix, mais elle les rend aussi susceptibles d'encoder et d'amplifier des biais présents dans les données d'apprentissage, renforçant ainsi des discriminations chez les populations traitées par ces modèles [1]. Cet enjeu est un domaine de recherche dénommé fairness, et est particulièrement dynamique, avec la réglementation des modèles d’IA qui évolue, comme par exemple avec l’AI Act de l’Union Européenne.


Pour mesurer et mitiger les biais discriminatoires dans les modèles, la littérature s'est majoritairement concentrée sur des variables sensibles binaires ou catégorielles (genre, origine ethnique, etc.), pour lesquelles les groupes sont bien définis [2-5]. Cependant de nombreuses variables sensibles sont intrinsèquement continues : l'âge, le revenu, ou encore la couleur de peau. Discrétiser ces variables en groupes est une pratique courante mais problématique : le choix des seuils est arbitraire, de l'information est perdue, et un modèle peut sembler équitable pour un découpage donné tout en restant fortement biaisé pour un autre [6]. Contrôler la dépendance entre les sorties d'un modèle et une variable continue reste un problème ouvert, notamment pour les réseaux de neurones, où il faut à la fois mesurer cette dépendance et la pénaliser de façon différentiable au cours de l'apprentissage.


Durant ce stage, le/la stagiaire explorera les méthodes de réduction des biais par rapport à une variable sensible continue pour des réseaux de neurones. Le travail commencera par l'implémentation des méthodes existantes (régularisations basées sur des mesures de dépendance telles que la corrélation maximale de Hirschfeld-Gebelein-Rényi ou “Generalized Disparate Impacte”, etc.), listées dans les références [7-8], et par la mise en place d'un protocole robuste pour les comparer, en tenant compte du compromis entre performance et fairness. Dans un second temps, le stage se concentrera sur la conception et l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes de réduction de biais adaptées aux variables continues. Pour cela, le/la stagiaire pourra s'appuyer sur des bibliothèques open source (PyTorch, scikit-learn), afin de rester dans un cadre de code reproductible et facile à adopter.

Pré-requis

Le profil recherché pour ce poste est le suivant :
BAC+4/BAC+5 : Formation en mathématiques appliquées, statistiques ou machine learning au sein d’une université ou école d’ingénieur
Stage de césure ou stage de fin d’études
Date de début : Hiver 2026-2027
Durée : 4 à 6 mois

Références

  1. Risser, L., Sanz, A. G., Vincenot, Q., & Loubes, J. M. (2022). Tackling algorithmic bias in neural-network classifiers using wasserstein-2 regularization. Journal of Mathematical Imaging and Vision, 64(6), 672-689.
  2. Buolamwini, J., & Gebru, T. (2018, January). Gender shades: Intersectional accuracy disparities in commercial gender classification. In Conference on fairness, accountability and transparency (pp. 77-91). PMLR.
  3. Cho, J., Zala, A., & Bansal, M. (2023, October). Dall-eval: Probing the reasoning skills and social biases of text-to-image generation models. In 2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) (pp. 3020-3031). IEEE.
  4. Li, X., Chen, Z., Zhang, J. M., Sarro, F., Zhang, Y., & Liu, X. (2023). Dark-skin individuals are at more risk on the street: Unmasking fairness issues of autonomous driving systems. CoRR abs/2308.02935.
  5. Thong, W., Joniak, P., & Xiang, A. (2023, October). Beyond skin tone: A multidimensional measure of apparent skin color. In 2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) (pp. 4880-4890). IEEE.
  6. Shilova, V., Malherbe, E., Palma, G., Risser, L., & Loubes, J. M. (2025). Fairness-aware grouping for continuous sensitive variables: Application for debiasing face analysis with respect to skin tone. In ECAI 2025: 28th European Conference on Artificial Intelligence 25-30 October 2025, Bologna, Italy-Including 14th Conference on Prestigious Applications of Intelligent Systems (PAIS 2025) Proceedings (pp. 5344-5351).
  7. Mary, J., Calauzenes, C., & El Karoui, N. (2019, May). Fairness-aware learning for continuous attributes and treatments. In International conference on machine learning(pp. 4382-4391). PMLR.
  8. Giuliani, L., Misino, E., & Lombardi, M. (2023, July). Generalized disparate impact for configurable fairness solutions in ML. In International Conference on Machine Learning (pp. 11443-11458). PMLR.

Develop regional partnerships with associations, media organizations, technology partners, and other industry stakeholders. Ensure events are connected to broader campaigns rather than treated as standalone activities. Develop content that reflects the priorities and language of US senior living operators. Work with internal subject-matter experts to produce thought leadership, educational content, reports, and webinars. Coordinate with Teton’s PR partners on announcements, contributed articles, awards, speaking opportunities, and media relationships. description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Category Manager, Bedding - UK/EU

We are seeking a regional Senior Category Manager, Bedding UK/EU to join our growing team reporting into the Head of Home UK/EU. This role is suited to a data-driven product obsessed all-rounder. It leads the execution of merchandising strategy across the Bedding category, with responsibility for driving regional performance through strong product execution, trading, and customer insight. In this role, you will play a key part in scaling Quince’s value proposition in international markets by delivering a compelling regional assortment, optimizing the customer experience, and partnering cross-functionally to bring high-quality products to market.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end merchandising for the Bedding category across UK/EU including assortment execution, launches, and performance tracking
  • Execute regional merchandising strategy in partnership with US Product Merchandising and international regional merchandising peers
  • Contribute to product ideation, helping shape new product opportunities and business cases
  • Work cross-functionally with Product and Regional Merchandising, Planning, Marketing, Technical Design, and Sourcing to deliver successful product launches—balancing inventory, go-to-market execution, and product quality (fit, sizing, and margin)
  • Analyse trading performance (sales, returns, margin) and take ownership of actions to improve results
  • Support pricing and assortment decisions for the region
  • Own product catalogue management and administration, including product setup, data accuracy, and system maintenance
  • Build site merchandising strategy, including PDP improvements roadmap and customer journey optimisations
  • Monitor ratings, reviews, and returns to identify and support product quality improvements
  • Manage regional product samples and merchandising assets
  • Maintain merchandising reports, tools, trackers, and pricing files
  • Take ownership of evaluating regional product compliance requirements and partner with Sourcing and Quality teams to execute

Qualifications required: 

  • Role is based in London / Madrid or Berlin with 4 days per week in-office requirement
  • 8-10 years of retail buying or category experience in Home Textiles / Bedding, with demonstrated ownership of category performance
  • E-commerce and/or DTC experience, with exposure to both startup and established (blue-chip) brands preferred
  • Proven track record of progressing within an organisation and demonstrating continuous growth in roles and responsibilities
  • Bachelor’s Degree, preferred
  • Strong product awareness, with a commercial mindset and attention to detail
  • Product obsessed, with experience leveraging data tools and external sources to drive results
  • Critical eye to anticipate customer needs (both the “science” and “art” of retail merchandising)
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using data to inform trading and merchandising decisions (e.g. sales, margin, return rates)
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in both executional and strategic support roles
  • Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as Planning, Design, Sourcing, or Marketing
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with particular ability to influence through concise written narrative
  • Motivated by working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, where flexibility to stretch into or out of functional comfort zones is crucial for team success
  • Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity and change.

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We are on the lookout for a Senior Java Developer to join our Elasticsearch team and drive our work on the Inference API in Elasticsearch.

The Elasticsearch Inference API is the integration layer between Elasticsearch and external machine learning services including Elastic's own Elastic Inference Service (EIS), third-party providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Cohere, Google), and self-hosted models. It powers features like semantic search, reranking, and generative AI across Elastic Cloud and in hosted environments.

You'll maintain and develop the plugin framework and REST API with your work spanning protocol design, streaming, async execution, billing integration, and with a tight collaboration with the wider inference team and the Kibana team.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Build and maintain integrations with internal systems and external inference providers, including schema negotiation, streaming (SSE), and error normalisation
  • Contribute to the inference plugin's internal architecture: task settings, chunking strategies, rate limiting, and provider-level configuration
  • Review open source contributions to the codebase and work with third party engineers to ensure their contributions meet our technology standards
  • Participate in on-call rotation for inference-related incidents
  • Write thorough tests: unit tests using ESTestCase, YAML-based REST integration tests, and rolling-upgrade tests

What You Bring 

  • 5+ years of production Java experience, with experience contributing to a large, established Java codebase. You know core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
  • Experience crafting ergonomic APIs and the ability to reason through tradeoffs.
  • Experience with low-level Java such as concurrency, parallelism, classloaders, etc.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge of JDK internals: modules, the Java memory model, garbage collection, database load, caching techniques, etc.
  • Experience with ML systems
  • Contributions to and ownership of open source projects
  • Knowledge of Java build tools (Gradle, Maven, etc), with a strong preference for Gradle experience.
  • Experience working in a platform team or developer productivity team

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

Open Roles

  1. Senior Manager, Global Raw Materials Procurement - Linen, Cotton & Other 
  2. Senior Manager, Global Raw Materials Procurement - Cashmere & Silk 
  3. Senior Manager, Global Raw Materials Procurement - Denim, Active & PKG Labels 
  4. Senior Manager, Global Raw Materials Procurement - Leather & Down

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE: 

We are looking for an exceptional Senior Manager, Global Procurement [Materials] to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices -done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency, harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where T2 and T3 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent, and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners.

Success in this role means achieving material cost at or near should-costing, below market indices, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business,contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global procurement strategy.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Commodity Insights: Establish a monitoring framework to forecast global market shifts, raw material fluctuations, currency risks, and macro-material trends. Deliver actionable intelligence to procurement and leadership on a regular cadence.
    • Build and operationalize a live tracking system for key raw material prices, currency movements, and supply risks to proactively surface threats and opportunities.
  • Upstream Cost Engineering: Construct and scale material-specific clean sheets to lock in baseline component costs before finished-goods production. Provide the costing foundation for Tier 1 negotiations.
    • Build material-specific clean sheets for all top raw material inputs to create pricing transparency and support Tier 1 negotiation. 
    • Support Buy Plan margin review to govern company margin target. 
    • Partner with material sourcing team to ensure transparent, competitive pricing from all key material suppliers (we own material, we own costing) 
  • Tier 2 (and Tier 3) Vendor Strategy: Map and design an upstream network strategy to consolidate raw material volumes across key material types and maximize direct-to-mill leverage. Reduce supply chain complexity while improving cost and availability. 
    • Complete mapping of the Tier 2 and Tier 3 vendor landscape and deliver a defined material and vendor strategy that reduces complexity, ensures capacity, and increases direct-to-mill buying power. 
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate upstream material availability into product design and development cycles, ensuring early-stage cost optimization and seamless material-to-finished-good transitions. 
  • Material RFPs: Design and execute RFPs tailored specifically to raw material vendors, yarn spinners/mills, tanneries, and textile mills. Own the full bidding process from vendor outreach through award. 
    • Consistently deliver product exceptional material cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations 
    • Negotiate and execute immediate cost-reduction agreements directly with Tier 2 material suppliers, while simultaneously institutionalizing repeatable negotiation frameworks to build long-term material maturity and sustainable competitive advantage. 
    • Partner directly with the Material Sourcing, Product Sourcing and Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to align on, and implement, material benefits into finished goods costing. 
  • Value Creation: Identify and execute on opportunities to reshape the supply chain and extract new financial value beyond traditional sourcing boundaries, including verticalization and volume consolidation plays. 
    • E.g. How do we become a market maker for Cashmere, Silk, etc? Could we sell cashmere and silk to other retailers? How can we partner with other mills or manufacturers to build a verticalized supply chain for critical materials, like linen, from French/Belgian farms and scutchers to linen mills? How do we buy/sell commodities to manage price fluctuations (e.g. gold pricing, Cashmere pricing)? 

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 12-15 years of experience in raw material sourcing, commodity procurement, or upstream supply chain management 
  • Deep knowledge of textile raw materials including yarns, fibers, fabrics, leather, and related commodities 
  • Experience negotiating directly with mills, tanneries, yarn spinners, and raw material vendors 
  • Familiarity with commodity hedging frameworks and global market indices 
  • Proven ability to build and execute material-specific clean sheets 
  • Strong analytical and financial modeling skills; comfort with large data sets 
  • Technical aptitude for leveraging AI-powered platforms (e.g., LLMs) to conduct scenario analysis and automate complex procurement tasks.Experience in upstream supply chain network design or consolidation preferred 
  • Experience working cross-functionally with merchandising, sourcing, and production teams 
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree a plus

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

Mission Brief 

You will need strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders, direct reports and leaders within and outside the organization. You will be part of a team responsible for developing stage separation mechanisms, fairing separation mechanisms, hydraulic, pneumatic and electro-mechanical actuators and umbilical fluid and electrical systems. You have mechanical and integrated design experience as well as proven track record of delivering results on time and quality, while completing collaborative projects effectively. Your design, analysis and manufacturing skills enable you to own the outcomes of key mechanism design trades and development of our Spectrum Launch Vehicle.  

Your Role in Our Space Mission:  

  • Design of the vehicle mechanisms through design phases (CAD, drawings, sizing) until qualification and acceptance. 
  • Requirements definition for vehicle mechanisms 
  • Driving trade studies, manufacturing optimization and performance for mechanisms 
  • Interface with teams in static structures and propulsion, AGNC, AIT, production 
  • Creating, reviewing and releasing development and flight hardware drawings and design documentation 
  • Identifying build/test/design optimizations and working them to resolution 
  • Contribute to testing activities, such as definition of test plans and procedures, support to the test team in test execution and post processing 

 

Qualification Checklist 

  • Master’s degree in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering or related field with proven record of excellent results and timely execution 
  • 8+ years of experience in a product full cycle design engineering role, including CAD (Siemens NX preferred), assembly and test execution 
  • Proven experience with manufacturing processes, project management, scheduling/planning, materials and surface treatments 
  • Strong understanding and proven experience of ISO GPS or ASME GD&T tolerancing principles 
  • Experience with testing activities, definition of test plans and procedures, support to the test team in test execution and post processing 
  • Excellent understanding of kinematic synthesis, pneumatic/hydraulic and electro-mechanical actuation, mechatronics, instrumentation, structures strength, stability, fatigue failure modes and tribology 
  • Collaborative and communication driven attitude: team work is key to success 
  • Proficient English skills (German is a plus)

Bonus Skills 

  • Previous experience with kinematic synthesis, pneumatic/hydraulic and electro-mechanical actuation, mechatronics, instrumentation, structures strength, stability, fatigue failure modes and tribology in the aerospace industry. 
  • Experience in structure and fluid systems for launch vehicle design or equivalent aerospace product, complex parts manufacturing and assembly techniques. 
  • Strong experience with design engineering tools such as NX, TeamCenter, Solidworks, Catia or equivalent. 
  • Experience with structural sizing tools such as Ansys, Altair HyperWorks solutions, Nastran, etc. and with analytical sizing calculations (e.g. HSB, Brunn, etc.) 
  • Strong experience with ERP/MES Systems, product lifecycle management (PLM e.g. Teamcenter) and/or data management 
  • Highly motivated to join a European space company and make it succeed  
  • Willing to travel to the launch site and suppliers when necessary for hardware support 

 

Benefits

  • A track record of shipping reliable software, not only prototypes.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to find the root cause of complex system behavior.
  • Clear communication and good judgment when tradeoffs are not simple.
  • Curiosity, adaptability, and the desire to learn new technical areas.

  • Experience with ML model deployment, feature pipelines, evaluation systems, or data quality tools.
  • Experience with streaming data, event systems, real-time processing, or low-latency applications.
  • Experience with numerical methods, signal processing, filtering, state estimation, or robotics.

You will decide how we detect a booking failure in a clinic within 24 hours and what a healthy integration looks like. The hard integrations that nobody else wants to do. They are what makes Vocca hard to replace. How the team works. Engineering team is growing fast and will organise in squads. For this role we are looking a the senior who frames the work first, sets guardrails and reviews carefully. We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. With AI, this trade off is much cheaper than before. But the judgment about what not to touch is yours. We talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics and the support team that hears when something breaks. What we expect from you First week Get onboarded on the stack. Mission Brief 

You will be responsible for the structural analysis of entire assemblies belonging to our rocket’s primary and secondary structures. From trading design concepts to sizing and validating design iterations and examining the impact of manufacturing deviations, you will play an important role in guiding design decisions and pushing performance and reliability of our structures forward.

As a Senior Structural Analysis Engineer you will play a major role in improving our overall analysis and verification workflow by defining standards, sharing technical knowledge and reviewing your colleagues’ results and identifying action points. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Perform detailed stress analysis of aerospace structures and components using both classical hand calculations and advanced finite element methods (FEM), mostly of CFRP structures 
  • Identify failure scenarios and collaborate with design engineers to review and optimize structural designs. 
  • Define applicable load cases, addressing the impact of thermal, quasi-static loads (arising from random vibrations) etc. 
  • Analise and provide possible solutions to manufacturing non-conformities 
  • Develop test plans and support physical testing of components to verify sizing assumptions and qualify hardware.   
  • Prepare comprehensive stress analysis reports and documentation for internal/external use 
  • Improve our standards and toolchain for structural verification

  • Self-motivated, collaborative, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision. 
  • High degree of independence and confidence in assessing and trading design risks 
  • Strong engineering intuition with regards to load paths and failure mechanisms

Catapult is a world leader in sports performance technology, serving over 5,000 teams across 40 sports. We improve many of your favorite athletes' performances with our wearable tracking technology, video and data analysis systems, and athlete management products. Our technology offers objective solutions to sport-based challenges and can be found throughout the NFL, NHL, NBA, AFL, NRL, Premier League, Bundesliga, La Liga and many more.

Customers include the FIA, nine Formula 1 teams - including the 8-time World Champion Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team - the majority of Formula E teams, the winners of multiple Le Mans 24-hour races over the last 10 years - Audi, Porsche, and Toyota - and teams and organisers in both IndyCar and NASCAR. 

We have major offices in the UK (London and Leeds), USA (Boston) and Australia (Melbourne) as well as multiple smaller offices around the world.

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SPORTS AND WANT TO WIN

We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic Software Engineer (Motorsport) to grow our Motorsport development team as we expand our RaceWatch products into new series and tackle new challenges.

Based in the London office (3 days a week), you will be a key player in developing new capabilities in RaceWatch, focussing on one or two racing series, and also contributing to the entire RaceWatch suite.

We believe that our customers deserve the best platform, and we are on a mission to maximise and enhance their performance through delivering the highest quality experience. As a Software Engineer, you will help us drive our products and processes forward. You will be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead the development of our RaceWatch software for one or more motorsport series.
  • Work with product managers and customers to design features and prioritise tasks.
  • Identify ways to add innovative new features to the software.
  • Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code.
  • Contribute to code quality, organization, and best practices throughout the development process.
  • Maintain and enhance software reliability.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Degree in computer science, or another scientific or technical subject.
  • A passion for sport.
  • 2+ years working in a fast-paced, technical environment, delivering software to customers.
  • A proven track record of building applications in C/C++, or another object-oriented language.
  • Experience developing products, scaling them, and supporting them throughout the entire lifecycle.
  • An aptitude for working with complex data.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical staff, both internally and when speaking to customers.
  • A willingness to go above and beyond for the customer.
  • Ability to help cover live motorsport events at weekends on a rotational basis with the rest of the team.
  • An ability to multi-task and thrive in a dynamic work environment with changing priorities.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience developing Windows applications in Visual Studio.
  • Experience developing applications that process video.
  • Experience with ticketing and project management platforms, such as JIRA or Monday.
  • Prior experience working in motorsport is an advantage.

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication; to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries so you’ll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures.
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better. There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you are interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams, organisations and competitors on the planet! While we have access to many exciting opportunities, we also realize that we are here to do a very important job for our customers. As a result, we aim to work with purpose and intention. We look for people that fit into our team culture, those who actively contribute and individuals who are excited about what they do. 

In order to build the future of sports performance, we need the brightest talent. If you think you can contribute to the empowering, enjoyable and exciting Catapult environment, then we invite you to apply.

description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Location: Reddit has a flexible first workforce. Don't live near our office? No worries: you can work remotely from anywhere in the UK or the Netherlands.

The Ads Foundational Representations (AFR) team develops signals and representations of Reddit’s core entities (ads, posts, users, and so on), capturing the semantic, contextual, and behavioral information that Reddit Ads needs. We work on building embeddings to understand content and users' interests based on the content they engage with. 

Our team has the potential to highlight one of Reddit's biggest differentiators: genuinely curated, high-quality, extremely relevant, and daily updated organic content. We are a Machine Learning/Data heavy team with a focus on the following areas:

  • Multimodal & Content Embeddings - Make sense of organic (posts, comments, subreddits) and promoted (ads, shopping products, their landing pages) text and media content by embedding them into a shared space. 
  • Contextual and Behavioral Relevance - Working with Product & Data Science, establishing definitions of what ads are relevant to users and the content we show them next to, building metrics and fine-tuning embeddings to better reflect relevance.
  • Knowledge Graph Embeddings - Building representations for the Knowledge graph entities, e.g., intellectual properties/brands, to be used for high-precision targeting & business insights. 
  • User Intent Modeling - Leveraging various techniques to introduce user representations based on the content they interact with: batch & real-time sequence modeling, LLM summarization, etc. 
  • LLM-based Representations - Leveraging LLMs, VLMs, and foundational models to build complex representations of Reddit entities that improve ranking outcomes

The signals and features we create become a key piece in the Ads Delivery funnel, from targeting to the auction, as well as the Business Insights product and other advertiser-facing products such as Creative generation and optimization.

As a Staff ML Engineer, you’ll be in charge of setting the technical direction of multiple pillars the team owns. You will lead cross-functional ML projects end to end - from high-level business gap analysis to engineering execution. 

Roughly 50% of your time will be spent on technical leadership and mentorship (driving strategy & designs, cross-functional collaboration, raising the quality bar), another 50% being individual hands-on work (data analysis & engineering, modeling & automation).  

Responsibilities

  • Providing technical leadership and mentorship to MLEs in the team: driving designs & their review, establishing best practices in analysis, modeling and engineering, keeping the bar high. 
  • Working closely with team/org leadership developing technical strategy for content-based embeddings & relevance for Ads.
  • Developing new or iterating on existing embedding models for advertising use cases, ranging from aggregation pipelines to two-tower architectures and sequence models.  
  • Working with local and 3rd-party LLMs/VLMs: extract representations, develop evaluation methodologies, prompt tune and fine-tune large models to build state-of-the-art embeddings. 
  • Building data processing and inference pipelines for the models we develop. 
  • Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the various features we develop, end-to-end experimentation from internal benchmarks to downstream recommender system offline metrics to online experiments. 
  • Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of the ML systems by writing automated tests, monitoring performance, and implementing best practices for model management.
  • Participating in modeling and coding reviews: You will review work by other team members and provide feedback to ensure that it meets the team's standards for quality and performance.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience with the full lifecycle of designing, training, evaluating, testing, and deploying industry-level models.
  • Demonstrated Staff-level technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving standards and bar raising, leading complex cross-functional projects: from requirements, design to cross-team/functional alignment and execution without direct people-management authority. 
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to different audiences, both verbally and in writing. 
  • Strong track record of working on content rich NLP/CV problems at scale, and using embeddings as a tool to solve them. 
  • Established data-driven approach for ML system development. Excitement about working with data and readiness to look behind the metric numbers. 
  • Familiarity with the Ads domain and/or Search/Recommender systems.
  • Experience with mainstream DL frameworks: PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with our stack (Python, Pytorch, Airflow, BigQuery, Ray, k8s, kafka, GCP)
  • Tech leadership experience: mentoring junior engineers and leading complex projects. 
  • Hands-on experience with using/fine-tuning/building LLMs.

description: TL;DR We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help define the future of Lovable Enterprise. Some of the world's largest companies are already building with Lovable. Now we're building the platform that allows them to deploy Lovable securely, reliably, and on their own terms. How do you let an enterprise customer deploy Lovable inside their own cloud without slowing product development? How do you build a platform that works seamlessly across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud without compromising security or developer experience? Those are the kinds of problems you'll solve. You'll define the technical direction for the platform that powers Lovable Enterprise—from cloud architecture and sandboxing to networking, encryption, and identity. Why Lovable? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. Why join now? Very few engineering roles offer this level of ownership. You'll help define a platform rather than inherit one. Many of the hardest architectural decisions haven't been made yet, giving you the opportunity to shape the foundation of Lovable Enterprise alongside engineering leadership. Whether you've been a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, founding engineer, or CTO, we're looking for someone who's already operated with this level of ownership—and wants to do it again on an even bigger stage. What you'll do You'll define the technical direction for the platform that lets enterprise customers run Lovable securely and at scale. You'll spend your time writing software, making architecture decisions, mentoring engineers, and working directly with customers on problems that don't have established playbooks. Examples include: Defining the architecture for enterprise deployments across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, including deployments into customer-controlled environments. Building cloud-agnostic systems that give customers flexibility in how and where they run Lovable. Designing secure sandboxing and runtime environments for running untrusted code at scale. Setting the technical bar for networking, encryption, identity and enterprise infrastructure. Building the internal platform that helps our engineering teams ship faster. Mentoring engineers and raising the engineering bar across the organisation. Working directly with enterprise customers and cloud providers on complex infrastructure challenges. What we're looking for We're looking for a Staff-level (or equivalent) Software Engineer with deep platform and infrastructure experience who have set technical direction before. This is a role for engineers who enjoy building software that powers infrastructure, if you’re from a traditional DevOps background this is less likely to be a good fit. This is the role for you if you have: Strong programming skills in Go or Rust, or a comparable systems language (C++, Java or similar) Experience building enterprise products and working with enterprise customers. Designed and scaled distributed systems in production that are used by multiple teams. Built on Kubernetes (or a similar orchestrator) as a platform, not just deployed to it. Hands-on experience designing and running production systems across more than one major cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), with deep expertise in at least one. A product mindset. You care about the people using the systems you build, not just the systems themselves. Experience operating at Staff, Principal, founding engineer, or CTO-level scope. And deep experience in some of these: Shipping software into customer-controlled environments (BYOC, VPC, self-hosted, air-gapped). Sandboxing and isolation (containers, microVMs, multi-tenant security). Enterprise identity, networking and encryption (SSO/SCIM, KMS/BYOK, private networking). Our tech stack Languages: Go, Rust, TypeScript Cloud: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Cloudflare Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Terraform, Temporal, OpenTelemetry, CI/CD Data: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery About your application Please submit your application in English—it's our company language. description:
Charging your car should feel as natural as charging your phone. That’s the future we’re building: a network of EV chargers where life happens. We don’t just install chargers. We accelerate sustainable mobility. We obsess over partnerships. We grow relentlessly: our network, our partners, and ourselves.

Our mission is as simple as it is ambitious: Accelerate Sustainable Mobility by investing in, installing, and operating EV charging stations through an innovative business model. We help businesses find the right charging solutions for their customers and make EV charging more accessible, reliable, and integrated into everyday life.

We are Partner Obsessed 🤝 — creating tailor-made solutions that better serve our partners and their customers. We’re driven by the challenge of making EV charging simpler and more readily available 💡. And we’re committed to growing relentlessly 📈 — our network, our partners’ businesses, and the professional development of our team.
If you’re here, you’re probably not looking for “just a job.” Neither are we. 😎 We’re driven by impact and always looking for people who thrive on turning bold ideas into reality. If that sounds like you, you’ll feel at home here. We’re looking for people who see challenges as opportunities, thrive in fast-growing, high-energy environments, and want to shape the future of mobility, not just watch it unfold. At Powerdot, you’ll get freedom, ownership, and responsibility. The space to experiment. The chance to scale your ideas. And a team that’s always pushing the edge of what’s possible.

🚀 About this Role

As our Strategic Account Management Coordinator, you’ll hold a key position within the Sales team, directly responsible for the Major Accounts scope — partners who manage multiple sites across their portfolio. You’ll operate at the centre of the electric mobility ecosystem, where technology, infrastructure, and a dynamic retail environment come together.
Your mission is to grow and protect Powerdot’s most valuable partner relationships by building long-term trust, monitoring account and station performance, and turning insights into actions that improve partner satisfaction and business results. You’ll act as the bridge between our major accounts and every internal team, ensuring that partner needs are understood, prioritised, and delivered — while continuously raising the quality of the partner experience.

How You’ll Shape Our Story:
Your day-to-day will include:

  • Managing and developing long-term relationships with Powerdot’s major accounts and strategic partners, building trust and becoming their go-to contact.
  • Monitoring account performance — tracking key metrics to identify opportunities to improve partner satisfaction, station performance, and business growth.
  • Preparing and leading quarterly business reviews — analysing performance, extracting key insights, and building clear action plans to share with partners.
  • Acting as the main point of contact for partners — understanding their needs and coordinating the appropriate internal teams to address them.
  • Working cross-functionally with Operations, Maintenance, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and other Powerdot teams to ensure smooth account management and delivery.
  • Developing and implementing partner-specific initiatives — including promotional campaigns, special operations, and other commercial opportunities.
  • Monitoring operational station performance — proactively identifying issues, risks, and opportunities across the charging stations in your accounts’ portfolios.
  • Translating partner feedback into action — converting partner needs and business priorities into actionable recommendations for internal teams.
  • Contributing to process improvement — helping continuously improve Powerdot’s strategic account management processes and overall partner experience.

This Is About You, Not Us 🫵🏼:

  • 1–2 years of experience in strategy or consulting, ideally combined with experience in account management, business development, or a client-facing role.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — you can structure complex topics and turn insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — you can interact confidently with senior clients and coordinate across multiple internal teams.
  • Strong business acumen — you understand what drives partner value and commercial success.
  • A customer-oriented mindset — you put the partner at the centre of your decisions and act on their behalf.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities — you thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  • Interest in electric mobility, technology, and infrastructure — you’re curious about the evolving retail ecosystem and the future of mobility.
  • An ownership mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes and follow through from insight to action.

The Kind of Energy We’re Looking For:

  • We’re not into titles, egos, or corporate buzzwords. We’re into people who make things happen.
  • You lead and listen. You build trust with senior partners while staying attuned to what internal teams need to deliver.
  • You own your stuff. You don’t stop at identifying an opportunity: you turn it into an action plan and see it through.
  • You’re commercially minded. You understand that great account management drives both partner satisfaction and sustainable business growth.
  • You bring structure to complexity. You can manage multiple accounts, stakeholders, and priorities without losing sight of the outcome.
  • You’ve got a green heartbeat. Sustainability isn’t just cool, it’s core. You care about building partnerships that make electric mobility more accessible.
  • You balance rigour with relationships. You’re disciplined about analysis and follow-through, but you never lose the human touch with partners.
  • You grow on purpose. You’re eager to learn, deepen your commercial expertise, and help Powerdot strengthen its most strategic relationships.

How you'll be Powered up?

  • 🏥 Private health insurance coverage
  • 💪🏼 Gym membership to support your wellbeing
  • ⏰ Flexible working hours so you can manage your time effectively
  • 🌍 Annual offsite to celebrate achievements and connect with colleagues
  • 🤝🏼 Regular team-building activities with your local team
  • 📚 English training to support collaboration across all markets and teams
  • 🍩 Free office snacks, unlimited coffee, and meal allowance for every worked day
  • ⚡️ Special discounts for charging your electric vehicle

Our Promise To You
The best solutions come from different voices. We’re committed to building a culture where inclusion, respect, and equal opportunity are part of everyday life. At Powerdot, everyone is encouraged to contribute ideas, challenge assumptions, and create positive change.
Whether you’re strengthening a partner relationship, leading a quarterly review, or turning feedback into action, your contribution matters. At Powerdot, you’ll have the space to learn, take ownership, and help build partnerships that power the future of mobility. Your voice helps power the future — literally.

description:
Kurz und Knapp

Du bist gerade mit deinem Studium oder deiner Ausbildung fertig, liebst die tägliche Abwechslung in der Logistik und bist bereit für eine neue Herausforderung als Führungskraft?

Dann bist du bei Picnic genau richtig! Denn wir suchen nach einem Graduate Teamlead für unseren Last Mile Standort (Hub) in Hamburg. 
Die Hubs werden mit unseren bereits fertig kommissionierten Waren aus dem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) beliefert und sind als Verteilzentrum die letzte Station unserer Logistikkette, bevor die Einkäufe beim Kunden auf dem Küchentisch landen.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Teamführung: Stelle dein Team ein und coache es zum Erfolg. Du kannst auch tolle Events planen, um den Zusammenhalt weiter zu stärken.
  • Entwicklung zur Führungskraft: Du managst nicht nur die Schichtpläne, sondern übernimmst die Einarbeitung und Entwicklung der Runner (Fahrer) in einem unserer Hubs, und sorgst so dafür, dass alles rund läuft.
  • Liefermanagement: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung, wenn die Lkw mit frischen Waren ankommen, und sorgst dafür, dass alles passt! Und wenn etwas fehlt, organisierst du blitzschnell Nachlieferungen – du behältst immer den Überblick über die Logistik in deinem Standort.
  • Prozessmanagement: Du hältst den Betrieb am Laufen durch einen kontinuierlichen Fokus auf unsere betrieblichen Kennzahlen (KPIs) und garantierst, dass alles sicher und wie am Schnürchen läuft, ganz nach unserem Motto: “Safety First”.
  • Teamwork: Im engen Austausch mit dem Customer-Success Team, unserem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) und anderen Hubs machst du unsere Kunden glücklich.
  • Pünktliche Abfahrten: Dank dir sind unsere Fahrer immer pünktlich unterwegs zu unseren Kunden, damit wir unser versprochenes Zeitfenster einhalten können.
  • Bringe deine Ideen ein: Von der Koordination der Reparatur unserer Elektrofahrzeuge über die Gestaltung des Hub Layouts bis hin zur Rekrutierung unserer Runner - deine Ideen tragen dazu bei, dass wir gemeinsam weiter wachsen können und unsere Logistikprozesse auf ein neues Level bringen.

 

Das bringst du mit 

  • Ein Studium oder abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung in der Logistik, dem Einzelhandel oder in ähnlichen Bereichen. 
  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Führung von Teams - entweder im Beruf oder du hast bereits ein anderes Erfolgsteam gecoached.
  • Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
  • Du bist im Besitz eines gültigen Führerscheins der Klasse B.
  • Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten und ein selbstbewusstes Auftreten.
  • Du magst es, Entscheidungen auf Grundlage von Zahlen und Fakten zu treffen. 

 

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich. voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. In unseren Hubs steht dir jederzeit ein gut gefüllter Kühlschrank mit frischen Snacks, Getränken und Obst zur Verfügung – damit du bestens versorgt bist, wenn dich der Hunger packt.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Individuelle Mobilität: Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. Wir bieten ein subventioniertes Deutschlandticket und ein „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm an. 
  • Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.

Bereit für die Herausforderung? Dann bewirb dich, werde Teil des Picnic Teams und hilf uns dabei, zum besten Milchmann in Deutschland zu werden!

The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.
